sampling_initial.doc: messages logged per second before sampling kicks in

sampling_thereafter.doc: log one in every N messages after the initial burst

verbosity.doc: how much of each payload is written to the collector log

endpoint.doc: host:port of the OTLP gRPC endpoint

headers.doc: extra gRPC metadata sent with every request

storage.doc: id of a storage extension for a persistent queue

insecure.doc: send in plaintext; only for local testing

metadata_cardinality_limit.doc: maximum number of distinct metadata_keys combinations

metadata_keys.doc: client metadata keys that get their own batcher

send_batch_max_size.doc: hard upper bound on a batch; must be >= send_batch_size when set

send_batch_size.doc: number of spans, metric data points or log records per batch

timeout.doc: how long to wait before sending a batch that is not yet full

check_interval.doc: how often memory use is measured; 1s is the usual value

limit_mib.doc: hard limit in MiB; above it the processor starts refusing data

limit_percentage.doc: hard limit as a percentage of total memory, for containers

spike_limit_mib.doc: headroom in MiB reserved for allocation spikes

spike_limit_percentage.doc: spike headroom as a percentage of total memory

protocols.doc: at least one of grpc or http must be enabled
